headline: Korean convenience stores have a ramen machine
hook:
A ramen MACHINE?!
Only in Korea
up_next: Why every Korean app has a mascot

lines.text: Good evening. This is the Four Eyes Report. Tonight: Korean convenience stores.
Korea has over fifty thousand of them. In some neighborhoods, you can see one store from the door of another.
And inside some of them... is this. A ramen cooking machine.
Wait. A machine? That cooks ramen? For you?!
Statistically speaking, yes. You press one button.
I have been boiling water like a caveman my entire life.
Doctor Jiyoung, please stay calm. This is a serious news program.
I am NOT calm! I'm booking a flight to Seoul!
